children: France energy distributor and renewables producer's H1 revenue grew 24% yr/yr to €4.07 bln
H1 EBITDA rose 18% and net income increased 17% yr/yr
Company upgraded 2026 EBITDA guidance to €775-825 mln, citing strong first half
Rubis raises 2026 EBITDA guidance to €775 mln-€825 mln from €740 mln-€790 mln
Company expects high oil prices to weigh on demand in H2 2026
Rubis sees Caribbean activity supported by Haiti recovery, tourism and Guyana-Suriname economic growth
ENERGY DISTRIBUTION GROWTH - Co said strong activity in fuel, LPG and bitumen across Europe, Africa and the Caribbean drove higher volumes and gross margins
BITUMEN AND FUEL PERFORMANCE - Significant increases in bitumen (+44% volume, +54% gross margin) and fuel (+6% volume, +13% gross margin) supported H1 results
RENEWABLES EXPANSION - Renewable electricity production rose, with Photosol commissioning the Creil solar plant and increasing assets in operation by 32%
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the oil & gas refining and marketing peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Rubis SCA is €38.35, about 13.3% above its September 7 closing price of €33.86
The stock recently traded at 10 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 11 three months ago
Sept 7 - TotalEnergies to lower stake in Papua LNG, hand operatorship to Exxon
Sept 7 - Italy's Eni doubles down in Venezuela with rising hope of recovering debt
